main.window_title: Quickpass - School Attendance and Access Control

language.title: School Language
language.subtitle: Choose the language your School will use Quickpass in. You can change it later in School Settings.

structure.title: Grades and Sections
structure.subtitle: Add your Grades in order, first to last, and the Sections they are divided into.

days.title: School Days and Schedule
days.subtitle: Choose the weekdays with classes, the Late Threshold, and the wait between Check-in and Check-out. Add holidays later in School Settings.

key.title: Admin Secret Key
key.subtitle: The key stands in for an Admin's Badge to approve protected changes if the Badge is lost. Keep it somewhere safe.

settings.heading: School Settings
settings.subheading: Your School's policies. Saving needs Admin Approval, and Cloud Sync carries the changes to Supabase.
settings.grades_hint: Double-click a Grade to rename it. New Grades go at the end, and only the last one can be removed.
settings.sections_hint: Double-click a Section to rename it; its Students keep it under the new name.
settings.holidays_hint: A holiday is not a School Day, so nobody is marked absent on it.
settings.key_hint: Leave it blank to keep the current key. At least {min} characters.

users.heading: Wipe Every Badge
users.description: This deletes every Badge and its details, Guardians included. The attendance history stays. A backup of this station's database is saved first.
users.done: Every Badge was wiped. The backup is in {backup}.

history.heading: Wipe the Attendance History
history.description: This deletes the Check-ins, Check-outs and security incidents stored at this station. Every Badge stays. What Cloud Sync already sent to Supabase is not deleted. A backup of this station's database is saved first.
history.done: This station's attendance history was wiped. The backup is in {backup}.

badge_scan.heading: Tap the Badge
badge_scan.tap_badge: Tap the badge of the person whose history you want to see on the RFID reader.
